name: Names Contact Phone
description: A record names this phone number as the number to reach its contact on. The source is WILDCARD (omitted), like HELD_BY_HUMAN, so any plugin's type can point here without identity_core depending upward on it; keeping the source to the kind of record described is the drawer's job. Written only for a number stated with its country code; a number without one has no node to point at and stays on the record that stated it.
